# Environment

```{r}
packages <- c("tidyverse","kableExtra","tableone","cowplot")
lapply(packages,library,character.only=T)

# functions
source("./lib/common_functions.R")
source("./lib/consistent_themes.R") 

# Print environment
Sys.info()
sessionInfo()
``` 

# Data
```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS") 
```

## Figure Code
```{r,message=F,error=F,warning=F,fig.width=15,fig.height=7.5}
# Figure
figure1A <-  create_MIC_histogram(df$IR_log_2,df$IR_cat,"Imipenem-relebactam")+ MIC_IR_x_scale + ylim(NA,250) + figure_1_format + resistance_cat_scale 

figure1B <- create_MIC_histogram(df$MVB_log_2,df$MVB_cat,"Meropenem-vaborbactam") + MIC_MVB_x_scale + ylim(NA,250) + figure_1_format + resistance_cat_scale

# Legend
MIC_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(figure1A)
MIC_legend_plot <- plot_grid(MIC_legend) + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(t=0, 0, 0, b=0), "cm"))

# Create cowplot Figure
MIC_histograms <- plot_grid(figure1A + theme(legend.position = "none"),figure1B + theme(legend.position = "none"), ncol = 2, labels = "AUTO", label_size = 18)
figure1 <- plot_grid(MIC_histograms,MIC_legend_plot, ncol=1,rel_heights = c(1,.13)) 
``` 

# Figure
```{r,message=F,error=F,warning=F,fig.width=12,fig.height=6}
figure1
```

## Save figure
```{r}
ggsave(plot = figure1, filename = './figures/figure_1.png', width = 12, height = 6, bg = "white", dpi=900)
```
